pred-sql: WITH ranked_stations AS ( SELECT rental_methods, capacity, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rental_methods ORDER BY capacity) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY rental_methods) AS cnt FROM new_york_citibike_citibike_stations WHERE capacity IS NOT NULL ), median_by_method AS ( SELECT rental_methods, AVG(CAST(capacity AS REAL)) AS median_capacity FROM ranked_stations WHERE rn IN ((cnt + 1) / 2, (cnt + 2) / 2) GROUP BY rental_methods ) SELECT s.name FROM new_york_citibike_citibike_stations s JOIN median_by_method m ON s.rental_methods <=> m.rental_methods WHERE s.capacity > m.median_capacity AND s.station_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT start_station_id FROM new_york_citibike_citibike_trips WHERE start_station_id IS NOT NULL );

SELECT输出列不同：Gold SQL输出 rental_methods、name、capacity、station_id、latitude、longitude 共6列；Pred SQL仅输出 name 一列，缺少其他字段。2. 中位数计算方法不同：Gold SQL使用精确的插值中位数（加权平均），能正确处理任意数量的记录；Pred SQL使用取中间两个值的平均值（AVG），但在记录数为偶数时，其筛选条件 `rn IN ((cnt+1)/2, (cnt+2)/2)` 会产生非整数导致只取到一个中间值（例如 cnt=4 时 IN (2.5,3) 实际只匹配 rn=3），造成中位数计算错误，进而影响 `capacity > median` 的过滤结果。3. pred-sql: WITH project_gene_baseline AS ( SELECT project_short_name, Gene, AVG(Expr) AS avg_expr FROM qotm_paad_kirp_random_sample_1002 WHERE project_short_name IN ('TCGA-PAAD', 'TCGA-KIRP', 'PAAD', 'KIRP') AND Expr IS NOT NULL GROUP BY project_short_name, Gene ), high_expr_with_protein AS ( SELECT q.project_short_name, q.ID, q.Gene, q.Expr, b.avg_expr, q.Expr / b.avg_expr AS expr_vs_avg, p.protein_expression FROM qotm_paad_kirp_random_sample_1002 q JOIN project_gene_baseline b ON q.project_short_name = b.project_short_name AND q.Gene = b.Gene JOIN tcga_hg38_data_v0_protein_expression p ON q.project_short_name = p.project_short_name AND q.ID = p.sample_barcode AND q.Gene = p.gene_name WHERE q.project_short_name IN ('TCGA-PAAD', 'TCGA-KIRP', 'PAAD', 'KIRP') AND q.Expr IS NOT NULL AND b.avg_expr IS NOT NULL AND b.avg_expr > 0 AND q.Expr > 1.5 * b.avg_expr AND p.protein_expression IS NOT NULL ) SELECT project_short_name, Gene, COUNT(*) AS supporting_samples, ROUND(AVG(Expr), 4) AS avg_high_expr, ROUND(AVG(avg_expr), 4) AS project_gene_baseline_expr, ROUND(AVG(expr_vs_avg), 4) AS avg_fold_vs_baseline, ROUND(AVG(protein_expression), 4) AS avg_protein_expression FROM high_expr_with_protein GROUP BY project_short_name, Gene ORDER BY project_short_name, avg_fold_vs_baseline DESC, supporting_samples DESC;

pred-sql: WITH population_het AS ( SELECT Gender AS Category, Population_ID AS Entity, SUM(HetRateAuto) AS pop_het FROM simons_genome_diversity_project_sample_metadata WHERE SGDP_ID IS NOT NULL AND Gender IN ('M', 'F') AND HetRateAuto IS NOT NULL AND Population_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Gender, Population_ID ), gender_stats AS ( SELECT Category, AVG(pop_het) AS avg_measure, SUM(pop_het) AS total_measure FROM population_het GROUP BY Category ), ranked AS ( SELECT p.Category, p.Entity, p.pop_het / CAST(g.total_measure AS REAL) * 100 AS pct_of_total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.Category ORDER BY p.pop_het / CAST(g.total_measure AS REAL) DESC) AS rn FROM population_het p JOIN gender_stats g ON p.Category = g.Category WHERE p.pop_het > g.avg_measure ) SELECT Category, Entity, pct_of_total FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 5;
Effective diff desc: pred_sql在计算前对数据按Population_ID聚合求和，改变了原始数据粒度；gold_sql直接基于个体样本计算，pred_sql基于人群聚合值计算，导致avg_measure和total_measure的计算基准完全不同，且过滤条件也存在差异（pred_sql多了SGDP_ID等非空过滤）。

question: 在Simons基因组多样性计划中，男性和女性群体里，常染色体杂合率最高的人群分布在哪些地区？它们的杂合率比该性别的一般水平高出多少，是否反映了特殊的种群历史？结果需要展示性别，人种，常染色体杂合率，平均常染色体杂合率，常染色体杂合率超过平均水平比例，地区，国家
Gold-sql: WITH gender_avg AS ( SELECT Gender AS Category, AVG(HetRateAuto) AS avg_het FROM HUMAN_GENOME_VARIANTS.SIMONS_GENOME_DIVERSITY_PROJECT_SAMPLE_METADATA GROUP BY Gender ), ranked AS ( SELECT t.Gender AS Category, t.Population_ID AS Entity, t.HetRateAuto AS Measure, ga.avg_het, (t.HetRateAuto - ga.avg_het) / ga.avg_het * 100 AS pct_above_avg, t.Region, t.Country, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.Gender ORDER BY t.HetRateAuto DESC) AS rn FROM HUMAN_GENOME_VARIANTS.SIMONS_GENOME_DIVERSITY_PROJECT_SAMPLE_METADATA t JOIN gender_avg ga ON t.Gender = ga.Category WHERE t.HetRateAuto IS NOT NULL ) SELECT Category, Entity, Measure, avg_het, pct_above_avg, Region, Country FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3;
pred-sql: WITH gender_avg AS (SELECT Gender, AVG(HetRateAuto) as avg_HetRateAuto FROM simons_genome_diversity_project_sample_metadata GROUP BY Gender), above_avg AS (SELECT m.Gender, m.Population_ID, m.HetRateAuto, g.avg_HetRateAuto, (m.HetRateAuto - g.avg_HetRateAuto) / g.avg_HetRateAuto * 100 as exceed_percentage, m.Region, m.Country FROM simons_genome_diversity_project_sample_metadata m JOIN gender_avg g ON m.Gender = g.Gender WHERE m.HetRateAuto > g.avg_HetRateAuto) SELECT a.Gender, a.Population_ID, a.HetRateAuto, a.avg_HetRateAuto, a.exceed_percentage, a.Region, a.Country FROM above_avg a ORDER BY a.Gender, a.exceed_percentage DESC
Effective diff desc: Pred SQL多了过滤条件`m.HetRateAuto > g.avg_HetRateAuto`，只返回高于平均值的记录，而Gold SQL返回所有非空记录；Pred SQL未使用`ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Gender ORDER BY HetRateAuto DESC)`限制每个Gender前3条，而是返回所有符合条件记录并按Gender和exceed_percentage降序排列；因此结果集不同：Gold SQL每个Gender最多3条，可能包含低于平均值的记录；Pred SQL每个Gender可能多条，但全部高于平均值。

pred-sql: WITH gender_avg AS ( SELECT Gender, AVG(HetRateAuto) AS gender_avg_het FROM simons_genome_diversity_project_sample_metadata GROUP BY Gender ), population_avg AS ( SELECT Gender, Population_ID, AVG(HetRateAuto) AS population_avg_het, MAX(Region) AS Region, MAX(Country) AS Country FROM simons_genome_diversity_project_sample_metadata GROUP BY Gender, Population_ID ), ranked AS ( SELECT Gender, Population_ID, population_avg_het, Region, Country, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Gender ORDER BY population_avg_het DESC) AS rn FROM population_avg ) SELECT r.Gender AS `性别`, r.Population_ID AS `人种`, r.population_avg_het AS `常染色体杂合率`, g.gender_avg_het AS `平均常染色体杂合率`, ((r.population_avg_het - g.gender_avg_het) / g.gender_avg_het) * 100 AS `常染色体杂合率超过平均水平比例`, r.Region AS `地区`, r.Country AS `国家` FROM ranked r JOIN gender_avg g ON r.Gender = g.Gender WHERE r.rn = 1
Effective diff desc: pred_sql中population_avg使用AVG(HetRateAuto)计算人群平均杂合率而非取最高个体值，且WHERE rn=1返回每组最高1行而非3行，同时缺少百分比列的列别名处理逻辑与gold_sql一致但返回行数不同

pred-sql: WITH gender_avg AS ( SELECT Gender AS Category, AVG(HetRateAuto) AS avg_het FROM simons_genome_diversity_project_sample_metadata WHERE HetRateAuto IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Gender ), ranked AS ( SELECT t.Gender AS Category, t.Population_ID AS Entity, t.HetRateAuto AS Measure, ga.avg_het, (t.HetRateAuto - ga.avg_het) / ga.avg_het * 100 AS pct_above_avg, t.Region, t.Country, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.Gender ORDER BY t.HetRateAuto DESC) AS rn FROM simons_genome_diversity_project_sample_metadata t JOIN gender_avg ga ON t.Gender = ga.Category WHERE t.HetRateAuto IS NOT NULL ) SELECT Category AS 性别, Entity AS 人种, Measure AS 常染色体杂合率, avg_het AS 平均常染色体杂合率, pct_above_avg AS 常染色体杂合率超过平均水平比例, Region AS 地区, Country AS 国家 FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 5;
Effective diff desc: pred_sql中WHERE rn <= 5返回前5名，而gold_sql中WHERE rn <= 3返回前3名，导致结果集行数不同；且pred_sql使用中文别名，gold_sql使用英文别名

WITH daily_cnt AS (
    SELECT DATE(b.begin_shift_time) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS day_record_cnt
    FROM balance_information b
    WHERE b.begin_shift_time >= '2023-04-01 00:00:00'
      AND b.begin_shift_time < '2023-04-04 00:00:00'
    GROUP BY DATE(b.begin_shift_time)
)
SELECT 
    d.stat_date,
    d.day_record_cnt,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*) / 7.0
        FROM balance_information b2
        WHERE b2.begin_shift_time >= DATE_SUB(d.stat_date, INTERVAL 7 DAY)
          AND b2.begin_shift_time < d.stat_date
    ) AS prior_7d_avg_record_cnt,
    d.day_record_cnt - (
        SELECT COUNT(*) / 7.0
        FROM balance_information b3
        WHERE b3.begin_shift_time >= DATE_SUB(d.stat_date, INTERVAL 7 DAY)
          AND b3.begin_shift_time < d.stat_date
    ) AS uplift_vs_prior_7d_avg
FROM daily_cnt d
ORDER BY uplift_vs_prior_7d_avg DESC
LIMIT 3

    mc.NODE_ALIAS AS node_alias,

question: 我想看每类装置类型下，设计能力最高的装置名称分别是谁。
Gold-sql: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT t.UNIT_TYPE_ID AS topic, t.UNIT_NAME AS entity_name, t.CAPACITY AS qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.UNIT_TYPE_ID ORDER BY t.CAPACITY DESC, t.UNIT_NAME) AS rn FROM Refinery.pm_unit_t t WHERE t.UNIT_TYPE_ID IS NOT NULL AND t.UNIT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND t.CAPACITY IS NOT NULL ) SELECT topic, entity_name, qty FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY qty DESC;
pred-sql: SELECT t1.UNIT_NAME, t1.UNIT_TYPE_ID, t1.CAPACITY FROM pm_unit_t t1 JOIN (SELECT UNIT_TYPE_ID, MAX(CAPACITY) as max_capacity FROM pm_unit_t GROUP BY UNIT_TYPE_ID) t2 ON t1.UNIT_TYPE_ID = t2.UNIT_TYPE_ID AND t1.CAPACITY = t2.max_capacity
Effective diff desc: pred_sql使用子查询取最大容量后连接，当存在并列最高设计能力时会返回多条记录；gold_sql通过ROW_NUMBER按容量降序和名称排序取rn=1，每个类型仅返回一条记录

pred-sql: WITH agg AS ( SELECT u.UNIT_TYPE_ID AS topic, u.UNIT_NAME AS entity_name, MAX(u.CAPACITY) AS amt FROM PM_UNIT_T u WHERE u.UNIT_TYPE_ID IS NOT NULL AND u.UNIT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND u.CAPACITY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u.UNIT_TYPE_ID, u.UNIT_NAME ), ranked AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY topic ORDER BY amt DESC, entity_name ) AS rn FROM agg ) SELECT topic, entity_name, amt FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY amt DESC;
Effective diff desc: pred_sql先按UNIT_TYPE_ID和UNIT_NAME分组取MAX(CAPACITY)，导致每个装置类型-装置名称组合只有一条记录，再排序取第一，无法正确处理同一装置类型下不同装置名称的设计能力比较；gold_sql直接对每个装置类型的所有装置按CAPACITY排序取第一，逻辑不等价

pred-sql: SELECT DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(stackoverflow_posts.last_activity_date / 1000000.0)) AS day, COUNT(stackoverflow_posts.id) AS post_cnt FROM stackoverflow_posts WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(stackoverflow_posts.last_activity_date / 1000000.0) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(stackoverflow_posts.last_activity_date / 1000000.0) < '2026-02-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day;
Effective diff desc: 过滤条件中的结束时间边界不同：Pred SQL用 < '2026-02-01 00:00:00'，会包含 '2026-01-31 23:59:59' 这一秒的记录；Gold SQL用 < '2026-01-31 23:59:59'，不包含该秒的记录。当存在last_activity_date恰好等于 '2026-01-31 23:59:59' 的数据时，结果会出现差异。

pred-sql: SELECT g.id, MAX(g.date) AS latest_observation_date FROM ghcnd_2018 g WHERE g.date >= '2018-01-01' AND g.date < '2019-01-01' AND (g.mflag = '7' OR g.qflag = '7' OR g.sflag = '7') GROUP BY g.id ORDER BY latest_observation_date DESC LIMIT 10
Effective diff desc: Pred SQL多选了聚合列latest_observation_date，过滤条件从仅sflag='7'变为mflag、qflag、sflag任意一个为'7'，且对id做了分组取最大日期，导致返回的是每id的最高日期而非原始记录，排序依据也变为该聚合日期，与Gold SQL只按原始date降序取前10条纪录完全不同。

pred-sql: SELECT make AS rel_entity, AVG(width) AS avg_value FROM ( SELECT make, width FROM ECLIPSE_MEGAMOVIE.photos_v_0_1 UNION ALL SELECT make, width FROM ECLIPSE_MEGAMOVIE.photos_v_0_2 UNION ALL SELECT make, width FROM ECLIPSE_MEGAMOVIE.photos_v_0_3 ) AS combined GROUP BY make ORDER BY avg_value DESC LIMIT 10;
Effective diff desc: pred_sql使用了UNION ALL合并了photos_v_0_1、photos_v_0_2、photos_v_0_3三张表的数据，而gold_sql仅查询photos_v_0_2表，数据源范围不一致
